title: The golden's cached values for the circular interest/revolver loop were never converged, so they are internally inconsistent; a correct output fully recalculated in LibreOffice will differ from them by well over 1% in sensitive cells.
confirmation: Golden LBO caches are internally inconsistent: G124 (=+G133) caches 302.331 while G133 caches 302.547, and L103 (=+L135) caches 1367.25 vs L135 1373.24.
